purpose: Predefine acquisition failure semantics before any 2023-2024 holdout price row is queried.

query_failure_semantics.minimum_success_percentage_gate: NONE; do not invent a post hoc coverage threshold
query_failure_semantics.downstream_information_gate: The frozen V2.8.5 evaluator minimum valid securities/date and minimum valid dates determine whether evidence is evaluable.

snapshot_storage.normalization: One row schema across all sampled stocks, with canonical_security_id retained explicitly.
snapshot_storage.format: Parquet with deterministic sorted rows and zstd compression
snapshot_storage.partition_over_limit: BLOCK_BEFORE_COMMIT; do not silently change the frozen partition rule
